name: unknown_column
description: Column that does not exist on a catalog table; LLM pass cannot stand.

execution.sql:
SELECT e.full_name, c.currency_code, SUM(c.amount_usd) AS total_spend
FROM card_transactions AS c
JOIN employees AS e ON c.employee_id = e.employee_id
WHERE c.transaction_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
GROUP BY e.full_name, c.currency_code
ORDER BY total_spend DESC
LIMIT 10
